issues.ladybugdb_cypher_bug: MATCH (p:Person {id: $pid}) sometimes matches wrong nodes when combined with SET. Workaround: use MATCH (p:Person {name: $name}) for write queries.
issues.searxng_degraded: 6/11 engines unresponsive (brave, duckduckgo, karmasearch, aol). Google engine still functional.
issues.linkedin_auth_walled: LinkedIn profiles require direct HTTP fetch (browser UA). Jina Reader blocked. web_extract cannot fetch auth-walled pages.
issues.return_after_set: LadybugDB doesn't return rows from SET queries via get_next(). Workaround: use separate read query to verify.
